title: The Wolf Among Us
shortDescription: The Wolf Among Us is kept in GameAtlas's PC (Windows) adventure discovery path through frozen catalog organization and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference adventure marker within the PC (Windows) catalog.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Classified for the PC (Windows) adventure discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
